{{Quote|Stand back! I've got the season scepter! Or&hellip; an Icehead's club&hellip;|Teebo|<ref name="EwoksDate">{{EwoksDate|appearance of [[Icehead]] [[Club/Legends|clubs]]|[[The Season Scepter]]}}</ref>}}
The '''Icehead club''' was a [[Plant/Legends|wooden]] bludgeon used by members of the [[Icehead]] [[Species/Legends|species]], who served as guards and [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] for the [[Snow King]], a powerful [[Sentience/Legends|being]] who lived in the [[Snow Palace]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. The weapon was long and thin at its [[Rope/Legends|cord]]-wrapped handle, but it curved forward and widened into a paddle-like surface used to strike at a target. When used on [[Water/Legends|ice]], the [[Club/Legends|club]] was able to swat an object a long distance across the slippery surface. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Icehead clubs were used by both [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] infiltrators and Icehead [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] during a [[skirmish at the Snow Palace]].

==Description==
The [[Icehead]] [[Club/Legends|club]] was a [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] that had a narrow, two-handed grip wrapped in [[Rope/Legends|cord]] that extended for a distance roughly equal to half the height of its Icehead wielder, and curved backward. The club then curved forward acutely and widened into a paddle-like shape at the striking end. Thicker wrappings in [[Color/Legends|orange]] separated the weapon's tip, handle, and striking surface. Attackers were able to wield the Icehead club both over- and underhanded to strike objects within short distances. In the latter technique, Icehead clubs were able to swat objects long distances across [[Water/Legends|icy]] surfaces.<ref name="TSS" />

==History==
[[File:SnowKingIceheadClub-TSS.png|thumb|left|200px|The [[Snow King]] presents an Icehead club to [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket W. Warrick]] for his [[Belt of Honor]].]]
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="EwoksDate" /> each Icehead guard outside the [[Snow Palace]]&mdash;home to a powerful [[Sentience/Legends|being]] known as the [[Snow King]]&mdash;kept watch with an Icehead club slung over the shoulder. Icehead [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in the Snow King's throne room also employed the weapon. That [[Summer/Legends|summer]], three [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] from [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]]&mdash;[[Latara/Legends|Latara]], [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]], and [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]]&mdash;used snow to disguise themselves as Iceheads and sneaked into the Snow Palace, where they hoped to rescue their friend, [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]], from the Snow King and his mistress, the [[Frost Sprite]] [[Odra]], and to recover the [[season scepter]], which the enchanted [[King/Legends|monarch]] used to cause perpetual [[Winter/Legends|winter]] on Endor.<ref name="TSS" />

When they reached the Snow King's throne room, a [[Skirmish at the Snow Palace|skirmish]] erupted between Icehead forces and the Ewoks. During the fracas, Teebo used an Icehead club to bat away Iceheads who attacked him while sliding on their heads. The Ewoks reclaimed the season scepter and broke the enchantment placed on the Snow King by Odra. As a reward, the king gave Warrick an Icehead club to adorn his [[Belt of Honor]].<ref name="TSS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Icehead clubs appear in "[[The Season Scepter]]," an episode of the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] animated series that was written by [[Bob Carrau]] and first aired during the show's second season on [[November 1]], [[1986]].<ref name="SWC 67">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
